Name: Subtly Easier Fishing
Author: AzureblueZ29
Description:
[size=6][b]Subtly Easier Fishing[/b][/size]

I went looking for a fishing mod for my wife who has a mild case of cerebral palsy, which makes her right hand a bit less responsive. Every mod I found:

[list]
[*]Skipped the minigame entirely
[*]Flattened the minigame so that movement and difficulty were always identical and boring
[*]Gave a million options that required you to become a doctor of Stardew Valley's internal fishing minigame mechanics
[/list]
There wasn't a mod that fit what I was looking for, so I made one. A mod that makes fishing subtly (just a little bit) easier in a way that the player wouldn't notice. A mod that made the fishing game fun instead of frustrating for someone with accessibility issues. A mod that wasn't overly complex.
[size=5][b]
Prerequisites[/b][/size]

Mandatory and optional requirements for use of this mod.
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI 4.0+[/url]﻿﻿ (required)
[/list]
[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Download and install the required prerequisites.
[*]Download the latest version of this mod.
[*]Unzip the downloaded file into the [u]Stardew Valley/Mods[/u] directory.
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

This mod can be run without any configuration at all, if desired.

If you run the mod without any configuration it will default to assisting with fish at difficulty 70 (Tuna, Eel) and above only. It will reduce the difficulty of those fish by 25%.

The mod's configurable options can be found below. These can either be adjusted through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Configuration Menu (GMCM)[/url] or the [u]config.json[/u] file. Editing the options using GMCM is easier. GMCM will also provide descriptive tooltips if the option itself is not clear.

[size=4][b]Enabled[/b][/size]

True/False - can be changed at any time.

[size=4][b]Only fish as hard as[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Legend (110)
[*]Glacier Fish (100)
[*]Lava Eel (90)
[*]Super Cucumber (80)
[*][b]Tuna (70)  (default/recommended)[/b]
[*]Largemouth Bass (50)
[*]Perch (35)
[*]Carp (15)
[/list]
Assistance will only reduce difficulty for fish this hard or harder. Anything easier will be unaffected.

[size=4][b]The percentage difficulty will be reduced by[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]50%
[*]35%
[*][b]25% (default/recommended)[/b]
[*]15%
[*]5%
[/list]
This is the percentage the difficulty stat will be reduced by if the fish meets the difficulty threshold.

[size=5][b]How to Use[/b][/size]

Start fishing - simple!

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

This mod is made for [b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b] using [b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b]. This mod will [b]not[/b] work on versions prior to those mentioned.

This mod does not change anything but fishing difficulty, so it [i]should[/i] work with most all mods except those that also adjust fishing the difficulty stat specifically. I have tested it with SVE successfully.

There is an Enabled true/false toggle you can use to turn the mod on and off at any time if you notice a conflict.

[size=5][b]Translations[/b][/size]

The only text this mod affects is in the GMCM mod options. At the time it is only English, but I'm willing to add additional languages if the mod becomes widely used. It would be pretty easy as it is only a few lines of text.
